mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that suppresses equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises while inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains below 3.0%, it indicates a policy response to inflation without excessive tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as central banks aggressively tighten policy, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months indicates a tightening labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods with declining UNRATE are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening real estate market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods with HOUST < 1400.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 102.0 while real GDP (GDPC1) remains above 24000.0 billion dollars, it indicates a temporary supply disruption without a demand collapse, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (HOUST > 1500.0 and UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to overheat due to excessive risk-taking, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion regimes (HOUST > 1500.0 and UNRATE < 4.0%) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
